Welcome to the Qantas Skybed
Whether you are relaxing, working, being entertained or sleeping, your
comfort is our priority. With extensive seat adjustments and an inbuilt back
massager, the Qantas Skybed offers outstanding comfort in every position,
while the unique cocoon-style design provides new levels of privacy.

Skybed Operation
Instructions for operation of seat features
Dome light - Located on the inner top of the cocoon and only visible when the seat back is reclined.
To operate touch light once for 'dim' light setting, touch again for "bright' light setting and again to turn off.
Headset socket - Located underneath the reading light.
AC PC power outlet - Located at the base of the centre console, it will accept most plugs (with the
exception of UK plugs). The power available is 110v and 60v. To use, insert the plug into the outlet, turn
clockwise a quarter turn and then insert fully.

LED reading light - Located between the
seats, at the side of the cocoon. Lift out
and the reading light will come on
automatically. Light intensity can be
modified by adjusting the slide on top.
Privacy screen - Located between reading
lights in the centre of the seats and is
operated by pressing the button located
directly above it. It releases automatically,
but must be stowed manually.
Additional cocktail tray - Located at the
front of the centre console. To operate pull
up and flip forward.
Headset storage - Located below the
inflight entertainment handset on the side
of the centre console.
Shoe storage - Located between the seats
in front of you.
A4/folio storage - Located under the
cocktail table at the front of the centre
console. To operate, insert fingers
underneath lip and lift up and out.
Meal table - To operate, use handle to pull
table up and out.
Glove box - Located on top of the centre
console at rear. It is useful for personal
items such as spectacles and wallets.
Seat Back Features
Handle - For ease of access in and out of seat.
Coat hook - Press button to deploy.
Inflight entertainment screen - Tilt personal
video screen for optimal viewing. Front row
seats have in-arm screens - pull latch
to release.
On some B747-400 aircraft, some features of the Skybed
seat may differ slightly.
Need to stretch your legs?
Our inflight bar, located on the main deck, gives you the flexibility to fix yourself a drink
or quick snack.
